# MN Home Sale Pros

> MN Home Sale Pros is a free directory of Minnesota home-sale inspection professionals: MPCA-licensed SSTS (septic) inspectors, MDH-licensed radon testers and mitigators, and city-licensed Truth-in-Sale-of-Housing (TISH) evaluators, organized by county.

It is for Minnesota sellers, buyers and agents dealing with septic compliance inspections at transfer, radon disclosure and testing, and city point-of-sale (TISH) evaluations. For Minneapolis, we link the city's official evaluator finder. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://mnhomesalepros.com/index.md).

## Directory
- [Minnesota Home Sale Inspectors by County](https://mnhomesalepros.com/counties/)
- [MPCA-Licensed SSTS (Septic) Inspectors in Minnesota](https://mnhomesalepros.com/septic-inspectors/): MPCA SSTS
- [Minnesota Radon at Home Sale & MDH-Licensed Radon Pros](https://mnhomesalepros.com/radon/): MDH radon + disclosure law
- [Minnesota Truth-in-Sale of Housing (TISH) & Point-of-Sale Inspections](https://mnhomesalepros.com/truth-in-sale-of-housing/): TISH hub
